CleaningBanner1.description: We provide reliable, affordable, and eco-friendly cleaning services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces.

paragraphs: At PureShine, we believe a clean space creates a healthier, happier and more productive life. We provide reliable, high-quality cleaning services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces with trained professionals and eco-friendly products.

CleaningWhyChooseUs1.description: We are committed to delivering high-quality cleaning services that make your home or workplace cleaner, healthier and more comfortable. Here's why our clients trust us.

features.title: Eco-Friendly Products
features.description: Safe for you, your family and the environment.

features.title: Reliable & On-Time
features.description: We value your time and always arrive on schedule.

benefits.title: Customized Solutions
benefits.description: Cleaning plans as per your needs.

CleaningServices1.heading: Our Popular
CleaningServices1.description: We offer a wide range of professional cleaning services to keep your spaces fresh, healthy and spotless.

items.title: Home Cleaning
items.description: A clean and healthy home for a happier you.
items.longDescription: Our home cleaning service is designed to bring a spotless, healthy environment to every room in your house. From dusting and vacuuming to wiping down surfaces and sanitising bathrooms, our trained professionals handle every detail so you can focus on what matters most. We use safe, eco-friendly products that are tough on grime but gentle on your family and pets.
features: Full room cleaning including bedrooms, living areas and hallways
Vacuuming, sweeping and mopping all floor types

process.title: Book Online
process.description: Choose your service, select a date and time, and confirm your booking in minutes.

process.title: We Arrive & Inspect
process.description: Our team arrives on time, inspects your home and creates a tailored cleaning plan.

process.title: Deep Clean
process.description: We clean every room thoroughly using professional equipment and eco-friendly products.

process.title: Final Check
process.description: We do a quality walkthrough before leaving to make sure you are completely satisfied.

items.footer: Whether it's your living room, bedroom, kitchen, or bathroom, our trained cleaning specialists go beyond routine surface cleaning to deliver a deeper, healthier living environment that you can see, feel, and enjoy every day. We utilize certified eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning agents and modern HEPA filtration equipment that effectively eliminate hidden allergens, microscopic bacteria, and accumulated grime while keeping children and pets completely safe. Every cleaning session is customized to the layout and lifestyle needs of your household, ensuring spotless results, sanitized high-touch surfaces, and genuine peace of mind.

items.title: Office Cleaning
items.tagline: A cleaner office means a sharper team.
items.longDescription: First impressions matter. Our professional office cleaning service ensures your workplace is spotless, hygienic and welcoming every single day. We work around your schedule — early morning, evenings or weekends — so your business is never disrupted. From reception areas to meeting rooms, restrooms and open-plan desks, we cover it all with precision and care.

process.title: Schedule a Visit
process.description: Contact us and we will arrange a free on-site assessment to understand your needs.

process.title: Custom Plan
process.description: We create a bespoke cleaning schedule tailored to your office size and hours.

process.title: Regular Cleaning
process.description: Our team arrives as scheduled and delivers consistent, high-quality results every time.

process.title: Ongoing Support
process.description: We stay in touch with regular check-ins and adapt our service as your needs change.

items.footer: Whether it's executive boardrooms, open workstations, client reception lounges, or employee break areas, our certified commercial cleaning experts deliver an immaculate, thoroughly sanitized workspace that actively fosters team productivity, morale, and everyday wellness. We provide highly flexible scheduling options—including early mornings, evening shifts, and weekend maintenance—to ensure your daily business operations remain entirely uninterrupted. From hospital-grade surface disinfection to detailed electronic equipment wipe-downs and commercial waste management, we uphold strict standards of cleanliness that project professionalism to every visiting client and partner.

items.title: Kitchen Cleaning
items.description: Hygienic and spotless kitchens for safer living.
items.longDescription: The kitchen is the heart of your home, and it deserves the deepest clean. Grease build-up, stained tiles, dirty ovens and blocked sinks are no match for our specialist kitchen cleaning team. We deep-clean every surface, appliance and hidden corner to eliminate bacteria, grime and odours — leaving you with a kitchen that looks, smells and feels brand new.
features: Oven, hob and extractor fan deep cleaning
Sink and tap descaling and polishing
Tile grout scrubbing and splash-back cleaning

process.title: Book Your Clean
process.description: Select kitchen cleaning, pick your slot, and we will confirm within minutes.

process.title: Pre-Clean Assessment
process.description: Our specialist assesses grease levels and trouble areas before starting.

process.title: Deep Clean & Degrease
process.description: We apply professional-grade degreasers and scrub every surface to perfection.

process.title: Sanitise & Shine
process.description: We sanitise all work surfaces and leave your kitchen sparkling and hygienic.

items.footer: Whether it's heavy grease on stovetops, baked-on grime inside ovens, oily extractor filters, or neglected tile splashbacks, our trained kitchen hygiene specialists utilize non-toxic, 100% food-safe degreasers and steam treatments to eliminate bacteria and stubborn carbon deposits without harsh chemical fumes. We detail every critical corner—including sink drainage traps, countertop seams, cabinet handles, and refrigerator rubber seals—ensuring an immaculate culinary space that complies with the highest standards of household food safety and everyday hygiene.

items.title: Bathroom Cleaning
items.description: Deep cleaning for a fresh and germ-free bathroom.
items.longDescription: Bathrooms harbour more bacteria than any other room in the house. Our deep bathroom cleaning service eliminates 99.9% of germs using hospital-grade disinfectants and professional equipment. We scrub tiles and grout, descale taps and showerheads, clean behind the toilet, and leave every surface gleaming. Enjoy a fresh, spa-like bathroom without lifting a finger.
features: Toilet deep scrub and disinfection inside and out
Shower, bath and tile grout scrubbing

process.title: Book Online
process.description: Choose your date and we will dispatch a specialist bathroom cleaner.

process.title: Treatment Application
process.description: We pre-treat hard water stains, soap scum and mould with specialist products.

process.title: Scrub & Disinfect
process.description: Every surface is scrubbed, disinfected and rinsed to hospital-grade standards.

process.title: Polish & Finish
process.description: We polish mirrors, taps and glass for a streak-free, spa-like finish.

items.footer: Whether it's stubborn hard-water limescale on shower screens, discoloured tile grout lines, calcium deposits on chrome taps, or deep toilet bowl disinfection, our certified hygiene professionals apply hospital-grade sanitizers to eradicate 99.9% of bacteria, mildew, and foul odours. We scrub and polish every fixture to a mirror-like shine, paying meticulous attention to wall tiles, mirror surfaces, vanity cabinetry, and floor drains, leaving you with a sparkling, germ-free bathroom that feels truly fresh and spa-like.

items.title: Carpet & Sofa Cleaning
items.description: Remove dust, stains and allergens for a fresher home.
items.longDescription: Carpets and sofas trap dust mites, allergens, pet hair and stains deep within their fibres. Our hot-water extraction and steam cleaning methods reach far beyond the surface to restore your upholstery and carpets to their original freshness. Whether it is a stubborn wine stain, pet odour, or years of accumulated dust, we have the expertise and equipment to handle it all.
features: Steam cleaning for sofas and upholstered furniture
Stain and spot treatment for tough marks
Fast drying times with professional equipment

process.title: Free Assessment
process.description: We assess the fabric type, stain severity and cleaning requirements.

process.title: Pre-Treatment
process.description: Stubborn stains and high-traffic areas receive targeted pre-treatment solutions.

process.title: Deep Extraction
process.description: Our hot-water extraction method removes dirt, allergens and bacteria from deep within fibres.

process.title: Dry & Refresh
process.description: We speed-dry your carpets and sofas and apply a fresh-scent finish.

items.footer: Whether it's luxury velvet armchairs, high-traffic living room carpets, delicate wool oriental rugs, or fabric dining chairs, our certified fabric technicians use advanced dual-chamber hot-water extraction and pressurized steam to extract deeply embedded dirt, pet dander, dust mites, and persistent stains without harming delicate fibres. We apply specialized pH-balanced spot treatments and non-toxic deodorizers, followed by rapid moisture extraction to ensure fast drying times and a revitalized, velvety texture that looks and smells like brand new.

items.title: Window & Glass Cleaning
items.imageAlt: Professional window and glass cleaning service
items.description: Streak-free shine and crystal-clear views for every window.
items.longDescription: Dirty windows, hard water spots and dust accumulation can dim the natural light in your home or office. Our professional window and glass cleaning service uses purified water, eco-friendly streak-free solutions, and specialized squeegees to deliver impeccable transparency. We clean interior and exterior glass, frames, sills, and tracks for both residential and commercial buildings.
features: Interior and exterior window glass cleaning
Window frame, tracks and sill detailing
Hard water stain and mineral deposit removal
Skylights, mirrors and glass partition cleaning
Safe multi-storey access equipment and techniques

process.title: Free Inspection
process.description: We examine window types, height access and glass conditions to plan the optimal cleaning approach.

process.title: Pre-Treatment
process.description: Hard water minerals, pollen and bird lime are pre-treated with gentle eco-solutions.

process.title: Purified Water Wash
process.description: We squeegee and wash every pane using purified water technology for zero spotting or streaks.

process.title: Frame & Sill Detailing
process.description: Frames, sills and tracks are wiped dry and inspected for a flawless crystal-clear finish.

items.footer: Whether it's architectural floor-to-ceiling glass, high-reach skylights, office glass partitions, decorative balustrades, or sliding patio doors, our trained glass specialists guarantee streak-free, crystal-clear transparency using five-stage deionized purified water technology. We do not just wash the glass—we meticulously scrub window tracks, vacuum sill crevices, wipe down weather-sealed frames, and remove mineral scale, pollen, and environmental fallout to maximize natural sunlight and elevate your home or commercial views.

items.title: Deep & Move-In Cleaning
items.imageAlt: Professional deep and move-in cleaning service
items.tagline: Every corner detailed, every germ eradicated —
items.description: Intensive whole-home detailing and sanitization from top to bottom.
items.longDescription: Our intensive deep cleaning service goes far beyond surface dusting. Designed for seasonal spring cleans, end-of-tenancy inspections, and move-in/move-out readiness, we sanitize every hidden nook and cranny. From behind major appliances and inside empty cabinets to high baseboards, grout lines, and ceiling fans, we ensure your living space is pristine, safe, and move-in ready.
features: Inside kitchen cabinets, drawers and pantry wipe-down
Deep tile grout scrubbing and lime-scale removal
Detailed baseboards, door frames and light switches

process.title: Initial Walkthrough
process.description: We evaluate priority zones and specific landlord or homeowner checklists.

process.title: High-to-Low Dusting
process.description: Cobwebs, vents, light fixtures and doorframes are thoroughly cleared from ceiling to floor.

process.title: Intensive Sanitization
process.description: Appliance backs, cabinet interiors, tiles, and fixtures are deep scrubbed and sanitized.

process.title: Final Quality Sign-Off
process.description: We conduct a detailed 50-point checklist inspection to ensure 100% satisfaction.

items.footer: Whether you are moving into a newly acquired property, preparing an end-of-tenancy handover for full security deposit return, or conducting an essential seasonal refresh, our certified deep cleaning crew delivers rigorous, top-to-bottom sanitization that leaves zero corners unattended. We detail neglected baseboards, scrub grout lines, sanitize appliance interiors and behind heavy furniture, wash interior door frames, and disinfect high-contact switch plates to guarantee an immaculate living environment that satisfies the strictest homeowner and leasing inspection standards.

items.title: Commercial & Facility Cleaning
items.tagline: Built for business, perfected for people —
items.description: Industrial-grade facility maintenance and post-construction detailing.
items.longDescription: High-traffic commercial spaces demand heavy-duty cleaning and meticulous presentation. PureShine provides end-to-end facility detailing for retail storefronts, showrooms, corporate lobbies, medical clinics, and post-construction job sites. Equipped with industrial floor scrubbers, HEPA vacuums, and commercial pressure washers, we keep your business immaculate, safe, and compliant.
features: Industrial floor scrubbing, buffing and polishing
Post-construction dust extraction and debris removal
High-traffic retail and corporate lobby maintenance
HEPA air filtration and particulate vacuuming
Flexible night-shift and weekend service rosters

process.title: Facility Audit
process.description: We assess your square footage, flooring types, and shift schedules to draft an SLA.

process.title: Heavy Debris Extraction
process.description: Industrial vacuums and sweepers eliminate fine drywall dust and high-traffic dirt.

process.title: Machine Scrub & Polish
process.description: Commercial ride-on and walk-behind scrubbers deep-clean and polish all floor surfaces.

process.title: Certified Sign-Off
process.description: Our site supervisor verifies all health and safety checklists for immediate handover.

items.footer: Whether managing a high-footfall retail showroom, multi-tenant corporate facility, fitness centre, educational institution, or healthcare clinic, our bonded and insured commercial sanitation crew provides reliable, high-spec facility care tailored to rigorous industry regulations. We deploy commercial ride-on scrubbers, electrostatic disinfectant sprayers, and HEPA particulate air scrubbers on flexible night-shift and weekend rosters, ensuring seamless business operations, spotless customer-facing areas, and a pristine, compliant working atmosphere for your staff and clients.

CleaningFAQ1.heading: Frequently Asked
CleaningFAQ1.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our cleaning services. If you need more information, feel free to contact our team.

contactCard.title: Still have questions?
contactCard.description: We're here to help! Contact our support team anytime.

items.question: What cleaning services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide home cleaning, office cleaning, kitchen cleaning, bathroom cleaning, carpet and sofa cleaning, deep cleaning and other customized cleaning services.

items.question: How do I book a cleaning service?
items.answer: You can book a cleaning service through our online booking form or contact our team directly. Simply select your preferred service, date and time.

items.question: Are your cleaning products safe?
items.answer: Yes. We use carefully selected cleaning products that are safe for homes, workplaces and everyday environments.

items.question: How much do your services cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the type of cleaning, property size and cleaning requirements. Contact us for a customized quote.

items.question: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
items.answer: No. Our professional team generally brings the required cleaning equipment and products. If you have any specific product preference, you can let us know.

items.question: How long does a cleaning session take?
items.answer: The duration depends on the size of the property and the type of cleaning service selected. Our team can provide an estimated duration during booking.

items.question: Do you offer same-day cleaning?
items.answer: Same-day cleaning may be available depending on our schedule and your location. Contact us to check availability.

items.question: What if I am not satisfied with the cleaning?
items.answer: Customer satisfaction is important to us. If there is an issue with the service, contact our support team and we will discuss the appropriate solution.

items.question: Are your cleaners background-checked and trained?
items.answer: Yes, every cleaner undergoes rigorous background verification, in-person interviews, and comprehensive hands-on training before joining our service team.

items.question: Do you offer recurring cleaning subscription plans?
items.answer: Yes! We offer flexible weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly recurring plans with special discounted rates and priority scheduling.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and secure online payment gateways. Invoices are provided after every completed clean.

items.question: What is the difference between regular and deep cleaning?
items.answer: Regular cleaning covers routine upkeep like dusting, vacuuming, and surface sanitization, while deep cleaning tackles hidden grime, inside appliances, grout lines, and behind heavy furniture.

items.question: Is PureShine insured and bonded?
items.answer: Yes, our cleaning operations and professional teams are fully insured and bonded to give you complete peace of mind while we care for your space.

items.question: What is your cancellation or rescheduling policy?
items.answer: You can reschedule or cancel your booking free of charge up to 24 hours before your scheduled appointment time through your account or by contacting support.
